title: Akbar ki sawari
body:
wawaila haye wawaila
na jaa akbar na jaa
na jaa akbar na jaa
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon se sadayein aati hai
akbar ki sawari jaati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon mein bapa hai wawaila
akbar ki sawari jaati hai
na jaa akbar na jaa
na jaa akbar na ja a
<<DIVIDER>>
hamshakle payambar jaata hai
dil baap ka dooba jaata hai
sar peet rahi hai maa dukhiya
akbar ki sawari jaati hai
qaimon mein bapa hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
athara baras naazon se jise
parwaan chadhaya zainab ne
gulshan hai ujda zainab ka
akbar ki sawari jaati hai
qaimon mein bapa hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi sakina ro ro kar
laut aao bhai ali akbar
qadmon se lipti masooma
akbar ki sawari jaati hai
qaimon mein bapa hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar se sakina jab lipti
shabbir ko sughra yaad aayi
usay kaise bataye ye baba
akbar ki sawari jaati hai
qaimon mein bapa hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch dayr ruko beta akbar
mai tumko bana to loo dulha
afsos na raas aaya sehra
akbar ki sawari jaati hai
qaimon mein bapa hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri yaad bahot tadpayegi
maa jeete ji mar jayegi
maadar ke labon par hai nauha
akbar ki sawari jaati hai
qaimon mein bapa hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jao akbar jao akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh kehte thay jao akbar
mujhe dekhte rehna mud mud kar
deta hai sada boodha baba
akbar ki sawari jaati hai
qaimon mein bapa hai...
author: N. Sarwar & J. Jaffri & A. Jee
